title: BKV's Integrated Operations Offer Value, Analyst Highlights Unique 'Closed-Loop' System And Growth Prospects
description: Truist Securities analyst Bertrand Donnes initiated coverage on BKV Corporation with a Buy rating and a price target of $24, citing the company's efficient 'closed-loop' gas production system and growth potential across its CCUS, Power, and Upstream/Midstream segments.
